data.description:
One verification pass over backlog tickets closed on 2026-10-02 because c11 1.0 (or earlier runs) absorbed them. Deliverable: for each line, a one-line verdict (fixed / still reproduces). Anything that still reproduces gets its own fresh ticket; nothing here is reopened wholesale. Run after the 1.0 sign-off build so the checks hit the shipped code.

1. C11-130, C11-169, C11-235 (terminal created but PTY never attaches; socket-created tab gets no PTY until focused). Claimed fix: C11-295 (cold start) + C11-296 (screen read starts a cold terminal). Check: churn-create 20+ tabs via `new-surface` into unfocused areas; every one answers `read-screen` within 2 s.
2. C11-197, C11-202, C11-205, C11-199 (SwiftUI graph-work, update/layout and generic-metadata hang families). Claimed fix: C11-301..304 producer fixes. Check: re-pull the main-thread-hang Sentry buckets for the first 1.0 release window vs the 0.67 baseline; file a new ticket only for a bucket that did not drop.
3. C11-138..142 (June 2026 audit umbrellas). Covered by the Truth & Stability run (C11-162..168) and 1.0. Check: skim `notes/c11-audit-merged-2026-06-09.md` P0/P1 items against main; file any real survivor as its own ticket.
4. C11-36, C11-38, C11-39 (remote agents over c11). Superseded by `c11 ssh` + Overwatch/Prime seats. Check: nothing to verify unless the direction changes.
5. C11-148, C11-149 (mail stranded after rename; stdin push flush check). Claimed fix: C11-257 messaging rework (lanes A-E). Check: rename a tab with undrained mail and confirm `mailbox recv` still returns it; confirm push lands at an idle prompt.
6. C11-201 (A-button ignores workspace.rootDirectory). `resolverCwdForAgentLaunch` no longer exists; C11-238 made the root govern new tabs. Check: A-button launch in a workspace with a root resolves project `.c11/agents.json` from the root.
7. C11-131 (crash resume never resumes Claude sessions). Claimed fix: #330 + C11-164 crash-recovery work. Check: kill -9 a tagged build with 3 Claude tabs, relaunch, all three resume their exact sessions.
8. C11-3 (installer / skill-copy UX). Settings > Agent Skills ships it. Check: none.
9. C11-147 (report_shell_state dropped: tab id vs workspace scope). Likely fixed by C11-248 rename and C11-297. Check: shell-state indicator updates on a fresh tab.
data.title: Verify backlog items absorbed by c11 1.0 and earlier runs (one pass, post sign-off)
